name: What is the process for kitchen cabinet installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for kitchen cabinet installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for kitchen cabinet installation typically begins with an initial consultation and design phase, where your needs and preferences are discussed. This is followed by detailed measurements and ordering of materials. Once cabinets arrive, the existing ones are carefully removed. New cabinets are then installed, starting with base units and ensuring they are level and secure, followed by wall cabinets. Finally, doors, drawers, hardware, and any decorative elements are installed. We coordinate all stages, ensuring a smooth transition and attention to detail from demolition to the final touches, including any necessary adjustments to surrounding elements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation involves consultation, design, measurements, ordering, removal of old cabinets, and precise fitting of new base and wall units, followed by hardware and finishes.
